name: testwright
description: All testing for any language and stack, any kind (unit, integration, end-to-end, API, property-based, mutation, snapshot, performance, data, game, exploratory): risk-first test plan, one run summary (failures, flaky reruns, slow tests, changed-line coverage), suite quality, characterization tests for legacy code, game tests. Knows .NET, Unity, TypeScript/npm, Python and Roblox Luau first and writes a reference for each new stack it meets.
